# Conservative Review

> > Conservative Review publishes investigative analysis and commentary on public health policy, vaccine efficacy, demographic trends, and conservative political perspectives on current events.

Conservative Review features in-depth reporting from prominent conservative commentators including Daniel Horowitz and Steve Deace, focusing on topics like COVID-19 vaccine skepticism, excess mortality statistics, demographic decline, and conservative criticism of Trump and 2024 election politics.

## Key Topics

- COVID-19 vaccines
- Excess mortality
- Vaccine skepticism
- Demographic decline
- Public health policy
- Scotland statistics
- Operation Warp Speed
- mRNA boosters
- Pharma accountability
- Birth rates
- Vital statistics
- 2024 election
- Trump criticism
- Conservative commentary

## Featured Commentators

- [Daniel Horowitz](https://www.conservativereview.com/horowitz): Daniel Horowitz analyzes Scotland mortality and demographic decline statistics
- [Steve Deace](https://www.conservativereview.com/steve-deace): Steve Deace commentary on vaccines, Trump, and 2024 election politics

## Vaccine Analysis & Public Health

- [Original](https://www.conservativereview.com/original): Analysis of COVID-19 vaccine efficacy, FDA approval, and vaccine skepticism
